text:
marco-partners: Connector Inc reached out — ready to start a small SI co-sell pilot. Need quick rules: lead routing, short escrow for conflicts, and announcement lead times. Can we decide today?

leena-sales: Baseline: SI-originated = SI gets first-touch credit. If Redwood first reaches out, Redwood keeps lead. For overlaps, propose 7-day escrow.

sam-salesops: I can add fields in SFDC: partner_source, partner_tag, escrow_until. Queue name `connector-si-queue`. I’ll automate tag+route on partner_source match.

eva-si: Connector asks for a read-only partner dashboard and a simple CSV upload for their contacts. Also wants joint demo at regional summit in 5 weeks.

chris-legal: Quick legal points: (1) addendum to capture credit rules and escrow window; (2) joint announcement requires signoff 4 business days out. I’ll draft templates.

marco-partners: Draft rules (short): attribution: partner_tag if partner_contact exists before our outreach; escrow: 7 days with status `PartnerEscrow`; SFDC: set `connector-intro` tag; announcements: PM+legal+partner approve 4bd.

leena-sales: Example CSV ok?

```
account_name,account_id,partner_contact,partner_source,introduced_on,partner_type,notes
FinServ Ltd,FS-1001,sam@connector.com,Connector,2026-03-05,SI,"intro at workshop"
```

sam-salesops: I'll provision partner dashboard read-only for Connector and enable CSV ingest. Will push automation by EOD Fri.

eva-si: Connector confirmed the summit demo slot. We'll need a short opt-in consent for any customer demo.

chris-legal: Drafting opt-in + addendum. Will post by tomorrow.

notify-bot: partner-portal.redwood.com/connector created, invite sent to admin@connector.com

marco-partners: Thanks — follow-up sync Thu 09:30 to finalize handoff docs and push SFDC automations.

leena-sales: Good for Sales.

eva-si: Connector confirmed Thu 09:30.

chris-legal: I'll join for the addendum review.
